read.en: SpaceX slipped 0.4% on Oct 26 to $146.90, trading between $144.57 and $150.24, with no 100-day average yet (94 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($149.3), 10-day ($149.8) and 30-day ($153.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($167.15), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月26日下跌 0.4%，收于 $146.90，盘中区间 $144.57–150.24；上市仅 94 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$149.3）、10 日（$149.8）和 30 日均线（$153.4）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，且处于零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$167.15），RSI 为 46。

read.en: $150 capped an intraday push, but the $145.4 Sep 28 low held. Resistance is $149.3–150.2 (5 and 10-day, Oct 26 high), then $153.4–154.3 (30-day, Oct 22 high) and $166.2 (Oct 21 high). Support is $144.6–145.4 (Oct 26 low, Sep 28 low), then $140.7–143.2 (Oct 15, Sep 15 and Oct 22 lows). A close above $150.2 would target $153–154; a close below $142.9 would open $140.7.
